notes: All 'we_will' bullet text is verbatim from the source document.
One-liners are verbatim from the summary paragraph at the bottom of the document.

PRIDE Values Matrix.pdf was also reviewed — it contains location-specific student behaviour expectations (classrooms, outside, bathrooms) and does not add value definition content relevant to book tagging. Not extracted.

selection_indicators are derived from the we_will bullets and are intended to guide the enrichment pipeline in deciding whether to tag a value. A book should only be tagged if a specific character decision, story event, or moment can be identified that embodies the value.
Values: Pride, Respect, Integrity, Determination, Excellence.

pride.one_liner: We take pride in ourselves, our school and our community.
we_will: take pride in our school, our community and all that we do.
represent our school with honour and respect.
wear a clean and well presented school uniform.
celebrate our own and other's achievements.
respect the school and learning environment.
selection_indicators: A character takes pride in their work, identity, culture, or community.
A character represents their family, community, or group with honour.
A character celebrates their own or another's achievement.
A character shows ownership and respect for shared spaces or belongings.

respect.one_liner: We respect ourselves, our school and each other, and understand the importance of treating others with compassion, care and courtesy.
we_will: treat others with compassion, care and fairness.
value and celebrate people's differences.
be a caring and courteous friend.
use kind words and be polite in all interactions.
include others in the classroom and in the yard.
show care and concern for self, others and school property.
selection_indicators: A character treats another with compassion, care, or fairness — especially across difference.
A character values or celebrates someone who is different from them.
A character actively includes someone who is excluded.
A character shows care and concern for others' wellbeing.
A character uses kindness or courtesy in a meaningful way.

integrity.one_liner: We model and demonstrate integrity by being honest, true and fair in all interactions.
we_will: make positive choices even when no one is watching.
be honest, true and fair.
take responsibility for actions and accept consequences.
follow our school values and expectations.
represent the school in all situations with positivity and pride.
be safe and considerate.
selection_indicators: A character makes an honest or ethical choice when it would be easier not to.
A character does the right thing even when no one is watching.
A character takes responsibility for a mistake or wrong action and accepts the consequence.
A character is faced with a moral dilemma and chooses honesty or fairness.

determination.one_liner: We show determination by using a growth mindset to overcome challenges, and use new and innovative ways to achieve our personal best.
we_will: try our best and find new ways to reach personal goals.
be resilient and bounce back from mistakes and setbacks.
use growth mindset skills and strategies to overcome challenges.
be positive and enthusiastic about learning.
strive for excellence but not perfection.
selection_indicators: A character persists in the face of difficulty, failure, or setback.
A character bounces back after a loss, injury, or mistake.
A character finds a new way to solve a problem when the first attempt fails.
A character's growth mindset or refusal to give up drives the story forward.

excellence.one_liner: We strive for excellence, aiming to be the very best we can be by setting goals and striving to gain new knowledge.
we_will: aim high to be the best version of ourselves.
be positive and enthusiastic about learning.
come ready to engage in learning.
set challenging learning goals.
be a positive example to others.
strive to learn and gain new knowledge.
selection_indicators: A character sets a high personal standard and works toward it.
A character pursues knowledge, skill, or growth with enthusiasm.
A character becomes a role model or positive example to others through their efforts.
A character strives to be their best self rather than simply good enough.
